Section1.DEFINITIONS.
CITY EMPLOYEE/EMPLOYEES.Employee or employees as usedin this ordinance
means civilian City employees, but does not include the sworn personnel of the Cheyenne Police
Department below the rankof chief or the sworn personnel of the Cheyenne Fire Department
below the rank of chief.
Section.2.APPLICABILITY.
These terms and conditions of employment apply to all City employees.
Section3.PURPOSE.

Section6.HEALTH, MEDICAL, DENTAL AND LIFE INSURANCE
The Citywill negotiate with or seek bids from qualified health insurance providers and will
enter into a contract with a qualified carrier or carriers to provide City employees with a medical
insurance plan, which is onfile in the Human Resources Department, forfiscal year 2019-2020
2020-2021.Each non-uniformed City employee eligible for health insurance coverage (including
members of the Governing Body) shall contribute ten percent (10%) of the monthly health
insurance premium attributable to thelevelof coverage selected by that employee.Thispayment
will be a payroll deduction.
The City will maintain dental insurance on City employees pursuant to the dental plan on
file in the Human Resources Department. The City will pay premiums for employees. If an
employee wishes tomaintain dental insurance under this plan for eligible dependents as defined
in Appendix B of the dental plan, he or she may do so by paying the premium for the additional
person(s) insured.
The City will pay premiums for term life insurance on all employees in accordance with
the term life insurance plan on file in the Human Resources Department and City Clerk's Office.
Section 7. TERM.
The terms and conditions of employment set forthin this ordinance shall applyfor fiscal
year 2019 2020 2020-2021 and shall be approved as part of the budget process. This ordinance
will terminate at the beginning of fiscal year 20202021 2021-2022.
Section8.REPEAL OF OTHER ORDINANCES
All other ordinances establishing specific terms and conditions of employment are
repealed.
